info.name: Stage Zomato - Ecommerce Backend (All User Stories)
info.description:
All brownfield user story collections in one place, grouped as folders:
- SCRUM-77: Category CRUD
- SCRUM-78: Product extended (categoryId + description) + SCRUM-134 duplicate-sku 409 tests
- SCRUM-100: OrderItem CRUD
- SCRUM-101: CartItem CRUD (uses SCRUM-133's Cart endpoint)
- SCRUM-102: Filter Orders by status
- SCRUM-133: Cart CRUD
- SCRUM-135: Consistent error handling (catch-all exception handler)

Each folder is self-contained with its own Setup sub-folder where needed, so it can be run on its own or as part of the full collection run.

item.name: SCRUM-77 - Category CRUD
item.description:

Base path: /api/categories

item.name: SCRUM-78 - Product Extended (categoryId + description)
item.description:
As a system, I want Product extended with a categoryId relation and description, so that products can be classified and described in more detail.

Branch: brownfield/scrum-78-as-a-system-i-want-product-extended-with (requires SCRUM-134 merged for duplicate-sku handling)
Base path: /api/products (categoryId and description are now required fields)

SCRUM-134: duplicate sku on create or update now returns 409 Conflict instead of an unhandled 500.

item.name: SCRUM-101 - CartItem CRUD
item.description:
As a user, I want to create, view, list, update, and delete CartItem records linked to a Cart and a Product, so that a cart can contain multiple line items instead of a single product/quantity pair.

Branch: brownfield/scrum-101-as-a-user-i-want-to-create-view-list-upd (requires SCRUM-133 merged for Cart creation)
Base path: /carts/{cartId}/items

Cart is now created via POST /carts (see Setup > 0c) - the previously required manual H2-console insert is no longer needed now that SCRUM-133 (Cart CRUD) is implemented.

item.name: SCRUM-133 - Cart CRUD
item.description:
As a user, I want to create, view, list, update, and delete Cart records (customerName, status), so that shopping carts can be created and managed independently before items are added to them.

Branch: brownfield/scrum-133-as-a-user-i-want-to-create-view-list-upd
Base path: /carts (note: not under /api, consistent with CartItemController's existing convention)

This closes the previously-missing Cart creation gap that SCRUM-101 (CartItem CRUD) depended on.

item.name: SCRUM-135 - Consistent Error Handling
item.description:
As a developer, I want a catch-all exception handler that converts any unexpected server-side exception into the application's consistent JSON error response, so that API consumers never see Spring Boot's bare default error page and every endpoint fails predictably.

Branch: brownfield/scrum-135-as-a-developer-i-want-a-catchall-excepti

This is a cross-cutting fix (GlobalExceptionHandler), not tied to one resource. The request below triggers a genuinely unhandled exception (malformed JSON body) to prove any endpoint now returns {timestamp, status, error, message} instead of Spring's bare {timestamp, status, error, path} default.
